info.title: Queue OpenAPI for speridlabs/iris-z/depth-to-image
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the speridlabs/iris-z/depth-to-image queue.

num_inference_steps.description: The number of inference steps to perform.
num_inference_steps.title: Num Inference Steps

output_format.description: The format of the generated image.
output_format.title: Output Format

examples: the same street in winter, snow on the rooftops
prompt.description: The prompt to generate an image from. Prompts are truncated to 512 text-encoder tokens. Leave empty for an unconditional image.
prompt.title: Prompt

seed.description: The same seed, prompt and depth map given to the same version of the model will output the same image every time.
seed.title: Seed

resolution.description: Output resolution tier; the depth map's aspect ratio is kept.
resolution.title: Resolution

depth_image_url.description: URL of the depth map to paint an image from.
depth_image_url.title: Depth Image Url

depth_format.description: How to read the depth map: `depth` (bright = far), `disparity` (bright = near), or `colorized` (the colored depth image returned by this model's depth endpoints).
depth_format.title: Depth Format

enable_safety_checker.description: If set to true, the safety checker will be enabled. Disabling it requires account authorization; unauthorized requests are always checked, and images flagged as unsafe are returned as black images.
enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker

guidance_scale.description: Classifier-free guidance scale. Defaults to the model's own value (3.5 for Iris-Z, 4.0 for Iris-Z small).
guidance_scale.title: Guidance Scale

has_nsfw_concepts.description: Whether the generated images contain NSFW concepts.
has_nsfw_concepts.title: Has Nsfw Concepts

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

height.description: The height of the image in pixels.
height.title: Height

width.description: The width of the image in pixels.
width.title: Width

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
